key_insight: Region-aware Mixture of Experts forcing models approach data-assimilation accuracy for axial-compressor flow while avoiding experimental-data input during deployment.
engineering_relevance: Learned corrections could improve baseline RANS predictions for turbomachinery flows without requiring ongoing experimental measurements.
method: Fuse PIV measurements, fixed-grid steady RANS and moving-grid hybrid RANS/LES using a Multi-Fidelity Ensemble Kalman Filter.
Train neural networks on the enriched database to map local velocity, velocity gradients and turbulent viscosity to discrete Navier–Stokes forcing terms.
Use a Mixture of Experts to select and combine learned models across flow regions.
evidence_signal: Against experimental data, the Mixture of Experts shows systematically lower discrepancies than baseline RANS and results very similar to MFEnKF, although the abstract reports no numerical error metrics.
watch_item: Standalone neural models can produce blade-tip errors exceeding baseline RANS; performance beyond the studied compressor conditions remains unestablished.
paper_title: Assisted Turbulence Modeling via Data Assimilation and Machine Learning for Turbomachinery Flows
